findings.title: Any successful tool call is treated as reading the omitted diff
findings.description: D4 leaves a PASS unchanged after any successful tool call. A directory listing or unrelated search, for example, does not establish that the model read the omitted files. This is weaker than the slice plan’s exception for a model that *did read files* and contradicts the value statement that a PASS implies the diff or files were read. Distinguish relevant file reads from other successful calls, or explicitly retain a coverage concern when that cannot be established.

findings.title: Deduplication can select the wrong answering model
findings.description: The design deduplicates models in first-seen order but selects the last entry as the model that wrote the review. For a sequence A, B, A, that selects B. A final turn that reports no model can also leave an earlier model presented as the answerer. Track the final answer’s reported model separately from the distinct run-wide list, and disclose when that final model is unknown.

findings.title: Synthetic finding omits the required location
findings.description: The slice plan’s 904 entry requires a `location:` on every finding, using `unverified` when no location is known. D4 explicitly omits it for the synthetic finding. Emit `location: unverified` so the finding conforms to the artifact contract used by downstream consumers.

findings.title: Total-budget truncation receives misleading remediation
findings.description: D3 records a diff skipped by the total-injection limit as zero injected characters, but D4’s synthetic finding attributes truncation to `review.max_file_size_bytes` and recommends raising it. That does not resolve an exhausted total budget. Preserve or determine the applicable cause and render advice for the total limit separately.
